entities.name: Wyrvil
entities.description: Fractious orc kingdom in western Almaaz in the Terisian Isles, ruled by underkings and overkings.

entities.name: Rotapan
entities.description: Small, aged half-orc overking of fierce fighting capabilities who ruled southernmost Wyrvil in 3050 AR.

entities.name: Erg Desert
entities.description: Desert raided and foraged by underkings.

entities.name: Sumifa
entities.description: City whose caravan was destroyed by orcs.

events.summary: A caravan from Sumifa is destroyed by an aggressive orc band, and the western erg route is abandoned, ending trade with Wyrvil.
events.quote: the caravan route through the western erg was abandoned completely, stopping all trade between Sumifa and Wyrvil

relations.note: He was overking of the southernmost realm of Wyrvil.
relations.quote: who ruled the southernmost realm of Wyrvil in 3050 AR
